notes.title: PAX Demo Finalization
notes.content: [p]Finalized the PAX Demo, including some optimizations, final polish tweaks, and added level 2 testing access (accessible via password temporarily). [/p]

notes.title: v0.2.13 Pre-Demo Playtest
notes.content: [p]Tons of bugs squashed, anims implemented and refined, sfx made more awesome, and the ending even more realized than before.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, a plethora of small tweaks, fixes, and optimizations.[/p]

notes.title: v0.2.13 Demo Prep/Playtest
notes.content:
Polish, polish, and more polish. 

Lots of bugs squashed, anims implemented and refined, sfx made awesome, and the ending more realized. Also, a plethora of small tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: v0.2.9 Changelog
notes.content:
- fixed void enemy starting action on any available player death rather than restarting only after being activated first
- fixed alignment of assets in demo_brontoGate04
- very minor asset movements in both demo and lvl1 versions of brontoGate04

notes.title: 0.2.8 V3
notes.content:
- fixed ladder dismount being blocked by player dismount in lvl1_welcome01
- updated pre-show video in lvl1_theatre02
- fixed toggle sprint and crouch options not being interactable with gamepad
- added new velocity-based wind sounds to showcase the player's movement speed better
- fixed ground trail disappearing after duration in lvl1_theatre02
- reduced room light levels and increased side room light levels to draw attention better in lvl1_theatre02
- added door after lvl1_diloDash05 that shuts once exited (despawns lvl1_diloDash05 to save on performance)
- fixed post process options not applying properly on start

notes.title: 0.2.8 V2 changes
notes.content:
- Fixed softlock in giftshop08 with INV items persisting in player's INV despite INVs no longer saving
- Players now get pulled out of hiding spots when cutscenes play
- Fixed dinos simulating physics in HuntFeed06
- Fixed fence issue in HuntFeed06 backstage that allowed players to jump through
- Fixed GoBackInTime03 floor grate collisions
- Fixed flashlight not saving when players exit and re-enter levels (any time the torch is spawned, it saves)
- Fixed post process settings not saving or setting properly (motion blur and brightness)
- Added vaultable box to the underneath construction area in HuntFeed06
- Fixed the door pivot in HuntFeed06 backstage
- Fixed mascot showing when players backtrack from HuntFeed06 to BrontoGate04 (or debug spawn after BrontoGate04)
